description: This file implements the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm (UAX #9) in Go, including classes, methods, and logic for handling text directionality, levels, and reordering for bidirectional text processing.

classes.name: level
classes.description: Type representing the embedding level of a character, with even levels indicating LTR and odd levels RTL.

classes.name: paragraph
classes.description: Struct maintaining the state of a paragraph for bidirectional processing, including types, levels, and matching isolate characters.

classes.name: isolatingRunSequence
classes.description: Struct representing a sequence of characters within an isolating run, with methods for resolving weak types, neutral types, and implicit levels.

classes.name: directionalStatusStack
classes.description: Stack structure used internally to manage embedding levels and override statuses during processing.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Method for Class type to check if it belongs to a set of classes.

methods.name: newParagraph
methods.description: Initializes a paragraph object with types, bracket types, values, and optional embedding level.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the main bidirectional algorithm steps on the paragraph.

methods.name: determineMatchingIsolates
methods.description: Finds matching PDI characters for isolate initiators.

methods.name: determineParagraphEmbeddingLevel
methods.description: Determines the paragraph's base embedding level based on strong character types.

methods.name: determineExplicitEmbeddingLevels
methods.description: Processes explicit embedding and override characters to set levels.

methods.name: determineIsolatingRunSequences
methods.description: Identifies isolating run sequences within the paragraph.

methods.name: assignLevelsToCharactersRemovedByX9
methods.description: Assigns levels to characters removed in rule X9 for internal processing.

methods.name: getLevels
methods.description: Computes levels array for line breaking.

methods.name: getReordering
methods.description: Returns visual to logical reordering for given line breaks.

methods.name: determineLevelRuns
methods.description: Returns array of level runs, considering characters to be removed.

methods.name: isolatingRunSequence
methods.description: Creates an isolating run sequence object for a set of character indexes.

methods.name: resolveWeakTypes
methods.description: Resolves weak character types according to rules W1-W7.

methods.name: resolveNeutralTypes
methods.description: Resolves neutral character types according to rules N1-N2.

methods.name: resolveImplicitLevels
methods.description: Resolves implicit levels for characters based on their types and current level.

methods.name: applyLevelsAndTypes
methods.description: Applies resolved levels and types to the paragraph.

methods.name: findRunLimit
methods.description: Finds the limit of a run of characters matching certain classes.

methods.name: assertOnly
methods.description: Validates that types are only from a specified set.
